understanding: Require LSR bit2 parity and bit3 framing to report 1 for top-of-FIFO erroneous character with read-clear and Receiver Line Status interrupt, verified via serial_data injection and wishbone_bus LSR reads after t_uart_cfg line-format setup.
preconditions: Dependency t_uart_cfg complete: LCR line format and divisor programmed via wishbone_bus; serial_data data_bits parity stop_bits bit_cycles agree symbolically with programmed format
Clock stable at fixed TESTBENCH period; reset driven to symbolic inactive level and released before stimulus

Ownership: wishbone_bus drives wb_adr_i wb_dat_i wb_we_i wb_stb_i wb_cyc_i wb_sel_i; serial_data drives srx_pad_i; modem_control_if drives cts_pad_i dsr_pad_i ri_pad_i dcd_pad_i to stable symbolic idle; observe wb_dat_o wb_ack_o int_o stx_pad_o rts_pad_o dtr_pad_o
Symbolic bindings: SYM_LSR_ADDR is actual 3-bit wb_adr_i pin value for LSR; SYM_LCR_PARITY and SYM_STOP track configured format; SYM_BIT_CYCLES tracks divisor timing; unknown LSR reset is null
stimulus_steps: STAGE parity_directed: SPAWN serial_data child driving only srx_pad_i with one frame with inverted parity bit under SYM_LCR_PARITY [f_pe_top]; SPAWN wishbone_bus child driving only WB inputs to read SYM_LSR_ADDR; WAIT both complete

STAGE framing_directed: SPAWN serial_data child driving only srx_pad_i with one frame with missing stop bit held at 0 where 1 expected [f_fe_top] [f_first_stop]; SPAWN wishbone_bus child driving only WB inputs to read SYM_LSR_ADDR; WAIT both complete

STAGE clean_recovery: SPAWN serial_data child driving only srx_pad_i with clean frame matching SYM_LCR_PARITY and valid first stop [f_pe_zero] [f_fe_zero]; SPAWN wishbone_bus child driving only WB inputs to read SYM_LSR_ADDR; WAIT both complete
IF additional FIFO depth needed THEN REPEAT parity or framing injection before pop to keep error at top; ELSE proceed to checks
check_steps: COMPARE LSR bit2 equals 1 when serial_data monitor reports top-of-FIFO character with parity error against LCR parity [f_pe_top]
COMPARE second LSR read via wishbone_bus at SYM_LSR_ADDR shows bit2 cleared after first LSR read [f_pe_clear]
COMPARE LSR bit3 equals 1 when serial_data monitor reports top-of-FIFO character without valid stop bit with only first stop checked [f_fe_top] [f_first_stop]
COMPARE second LSR read via wishbone_bus at SYM_LSR_ADDR shows bit3 cleared after first LSR read [f_fe_clear]
COMPARE LSR bit2 equals 0 and bit3 equals 0 on clean frame with correct parity and stop [f_pe_zero] [f_fe_zero]
COMPARE uart_interrupt int_o asserted while PE or FE set with IIR Receiver Line Status source until LSR read clears it [f_rls_int]
completion: WAIT all spawned serial_data and wishbone_bus children complete OR UNTIL TESTBENCH request_timeout_cycles expires as operational limit only
DRAIN wishbone_bus and serial_data monitors for drain_cycles as TESTBENCH operational limit then close virtual sequence
CLEANUP return wishbone_bus to idle symbolic levels via its driver, release explicit sequencer handles, leave srx_pad_i and modem inputs at symbolic idle

What is active level of wb_rst_i and inactive levels of wb_stb_i wb_cyc_i srx_pad_i cts_pad_i dsr_pad_i ri_pad_i dcd_pad_i and active level of int_o?
